text.p: A spokesman for Republican presidential challenger Bob Dole conceded defeat on Tuesday after television networks projected President Bill Clinton's re-election.

"Bob Dole has completed his last political mission with courage and honor," spokesman Nelson Warfield said in a statement. "Even in defeat, he has much to claim in the way of success. Bob Dole led his party in this election representing trust and conservative principles. With Republicans headed toward retaining the leadership of Congress, this country on the broadest front endorsed what Bob Dole stood for."
